content_sections.heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Senior Research Assistant at a Glance
About Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Senior Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a multi-campus, multi-disciplinary research deemed university. Its Amritapuri Campus in Keralam is inviting applications through Hut Labs to support ongoing research initiatives and project management under the guidance of a research lead.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Assistant position in Hut Labs. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a B. Tech or M. Tech in relevant field [ECE, CSE, EEE, AI, ROBOTICS]. In addition to the educational qualification, applicants are required to have B.Tech with 2+ years of experience or M.Tech with 1 year of experience.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Senior Research Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Supporting and managing research activities under the direction of a research lead. Designing and implementing research protocols, collecting and analyzing data. Preparing detailed reports and scholarly publications. Ensuring compliance with regulatory and ethical guidelines. Coordinating project timelines and contributing to grant writing and funding proposals.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Senior Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Interested and qualified candidates should send their applications and details to the official contact email provided in the notification. Review the required qualifications and experience. Prepare your application and supporting documents. For details contact [email protected] .
